title: Uruguayan Pecan Bread
description: A delicious and sweet Uruguayan bread filled with crunchy pecans, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a bowl, let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add flour, sugar, and salt to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Add chopped pecans to the dough and mix well.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet, cover it with a towel, and let it rise for another 30 minutes.
Bake the loaf for 35-40 minutes, or until it's golden brown.
Let the loaf cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
